decisions.reason: With no visible follow-on presence after its 2019 launch, this app likely fell short of aspiration levels for an adjacent, non-core digital service, so management would reallocate resources to stronger security-related activities or new search.

Because passenger processing technology fits the firm's airport-security process expertise and innovation strategy, a large firm in a growing market would likely use its slack to keep this newer technology offer despite still-uncertain evidence.

A self-service airline check-in solution sits farther from the firm's core security advantage and, without signs of sustained market traction after launch, would likely be judged below aspiration and discontinued.
